# Yondo Education

> Yondo Education is a career and study-abroad counselling service for students and their families. It starts with a free conversation, helps students discover what to study and where, and then supports university applications, visas and moving abroad. It is a brand of Bindal Univentures LLC, Sharjah Media City (Shams), UAE. The first conversation is free.

## Key facts
- Start: message on WhatsApp +91 91110 00194 (https://wa.me/919111000194?text=Hi%20Yondo%20Education%21%20I%27d%20like%20to%20book%20a%20free%20call.%0AI%27m%20a%3A%20student%20/%20parent%0AWhat%27s%20on%20my%20mind%3A%20) or email hello@yondo.global. The first conversation is free.
- Fees for the full programme, and for application and moving support, are explained in the first conversation, before anything is decided.
- Who it is for: students in grades 9 to 12 in India and the UAE, students taking a gap year, students planning a masters or a transfer, and their families; schools and universities can partner.
- Destinations: the UK and Ireland, the USA and Canada, Europe, Australia, Asia and Dubai.
- Independent: Yondo Education takes no commission from universities.
- How it works: start on WhatsApp or create a free account; a free call; a private discovery space that opens once a counsellor is matched (short questions, small challenges, one card at a time, no instant scores); a separate family conversation; a consultation and a Future Map; then, if wanted, help with university shortlists, applications, visas, accommodation, flights and the first two weeks abroad.
- No guaranteed outcomes: universities, scholarship bodies and governments make admission, scholarship and visa decisions.
- Founders: Harrsh Agrawal and Tushar Tayal (co-founders).
- Company: Bindal Univentures LLC, Sharjah Media City (Shams), UAE. Licence no. 2433960.01, issued by Sharjah Media City (Shams).

- [The discovery space](https://education.yondo.global/discovery-space/): the private space where students answer one card at a time; sign up free at https://education.yondo.global/portal/.
- [For parents](https://education.yondo.global/parents/): how families are included, permission for under-18s, honest conversations about money.
- [Choosing a country](https://education.yondo.global/explore/): destinations described by what they are like to learn and live in.
- [Schools and universities](https://education.yondo.global/schools/): programmes for schools and partnerships.
- [About us](https://education.yondo.global/about/): founders and how we work.
- [FAQ](https://education.yondo.global/faq/): answers to common questions.
- [Contact](https://education.yondo.global/contact/): WhatsApp and email.
- [Privacy](https://education.yondo.global/privacy/) and [Terms](https://education.yondo.global/terms/).
